records.head: 662823dd960367046ba7d73dd8fd25d15782865a
records.attribution: Inherited runtime/compatibility boundary in unchanged starting source; no P1 source edits caused this attempt.
causes: Two collector tests: the Node Bun.serve shim omits hostname required by the native Bun HTTP adapter; reload is also absent.
Stale-owner test fixture: the Node Bun.spawnSync shim omits the completed child PID, violating the existing required integer field before collector startup.
Witness compilation: the Node shim omits fileURLToPath and build; entrypoint preparation fails before a native compiler failure is established.

policy: Retain unsuccessful attempts. Do not exclude tests, weaken schemas, substitute runtimes or treat startup failures as accepted timing baselines.
